title: Collection
description: A LumiBase collection definition — represents a table of content items.

name.description: Unique collection identifier (snake_case). Used as DB table name prefix.

displayName.description: Human-readable label shown in Studio UI.

icon.description: Material icon name shown in Studio sidebar.

singleton.description: If true, this collection holds exactly one item (e.g. site settings).

status_field.description: Name of the field used as the status/lifecycle indicator.

sort_field.description: Name of the integer field used for manual drag-to-sort ordering.

archive_field.description: Name of the field that controls soft-delete / archival.

archive_value.description: Value of archive_field that marks an item as archived.

unarchive_value.description: Value of archive_field that marks an item as active (not archived).

accountability.description: Level of activity logging for this collection.
